resources.string: Let AI tools on your computer hand tasks to Mika

Off by default. When on, Mika listens on Wi-Fi and private networks (never on mobile data), so a CLI or MCP client on a computer in the same network can hand Mika tasks; Mika does them here on the phone and you see them as conversations. Every request needs the access token below. Payments, confirmations and steps handed to you can only be done on this phone.
Not on Wi-Fi or a private network right now
Use an address the computer can reach: the same Wi-Fi, or the same private VPN network. Tap an address to copy it.
Computers using the old token stop working until you give them the new one.
Add this to your MCP client’s server settings. Keep the token private: anyone on the same network who has it can hand Mika tasks.
Listening on port %1$d on Wi-Fi and private networks
Off. A computer with USB debugging can turn it on
Connected through USB (started from a computer)
Listens on this phone only; the computer reaches it over the cable

On a computer connected with USB debugging, run %1$s (tap to copy). It turns this on and prints the address and access token for AI tools on the computer; only the computer can read the token. Add “off” at the end to turn it off. It also turns off here, from the notification, and when the phone restarts.
Connected through USB on port %1$d (this phone only)
Port %1$d: over USB, and on Wi-Fi and private networks
